Turn a single Ubuntu server into a private, browser-based cloud operating system for you and your AI coding agents, completely secured behind Tailscale. 🚀

Are you tired of juggling fragmented self-hosted tools, exposing ports, and struggling to run resource-heavy AI coding workflows locally? Managing isolated development environments and keeping your data secure usually takes hours of manual configuration.

AgentVerse OS solves this by acting as your personal cloud operating system that unifies self-hosted infrastructure, browser-based desktop environments, and AI coding workflows into a single-server deployment. 

✨ Key Features:
• Rust-backed core cloudd handling APIs, CLI integration, workspace orchestration, backups, and an embedded Svelte 5 desktop interface.
• Isolated project workspaces powered by Incus and Coder, complete with inner Docker support and secure tunneling through localized Caddy gates.
• A massive 944-app store combining Runtipi, Coolify, and Umbrel catalogs with automatic credential management, snapshotting, and inter-app connectivity.
• Zero public exposure architecture leveraging Tailscale for secure, encrypted device-to-server connectivity and real TLS certificates out of the box.

Whether you want to run autonomous AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex inside secure, persistent server-side containers, or host a personal suite of developer tools with automated ZFS backups and instant rollbacks, AgentVerse OS gives you a ready-to-use remote development hub. Code seamlessly across laptops, tablets, and phones without losing state or compromising security. 💻

Check out the repository and give it a star:
https://github.com/agentverse-os/AgentVerse-OS

Language learning apps are broken. They suffer from terrible retention rates, lack real-time conversational depth, and lock your personal data behind greedy third-party cloud servers. 

Meet Mural: an open-source native iOS and Android language learning companion powered by direct OpenAI integration, prioritizing local-first data privacy and zero vendor lock-in. 📱✨

Mural solves the retention and privacy trap by giving you real-time voice and text conversation practice through a sleek native interface. Best of all? It keeps all your learning records strictly on-device, connecting directly to your own OpenAI API key with zero tracking.

Here is what makes it a must-have for developers and tech enthusiasts:
- Native cross-platform architecture built with SwiftUI (featuring Liquid Glass) on iOS and Jetpack Compose on Android ⚡
- BYO OpenAI API key integration securely stored right in your device Keychain or Android Keystore 🔒
- Local-first data persistence where all conversation logs and vocabulary states stay on your device, complete with JSON backup import/export 📂
- Adaptive conversation practice across 8 core language modules featuring live subtitle meanings, pinyin support for Mandarin, and AI-driven dynamic difficulty scaling 🧠

Whether you are looking to master a new language privately or want a production-grade blueprint for integrating real-time OpenAI voice workflows into native mobile applications, Mural is your ultimate open-source reference architecture.

Explore the source code, review the architecture, and start building today:
https://github.com/Chuloo/mural

Tired of the Electron bloat and the endless friction of stitching together tmux, separate SSH sessions, and disparate CLI coding agents? 

Meet Rune: a GPU-accelerated, native terminal multiplexer and development environment purpose-built to orchestrate modern coding agents across distributed peer-to-peer workstations. ⚡️

Rune solves the chaos of managing multiple CLI-based coding agents, background terminals, and language servers. It delivers a high-performance command center for your entire development workflow without the lag.

Here is what makes Rune a game-changer for AI engineers and power users:

🚀 GPU-Accelerated Native Rendering: Built on OpenGL for Linux and Metal for macOS to give you buttery-smooth performance with zero Electron overhead.
🔒 End-to-End Encrypted P2P Networking: Powered by headscale to securely connect instances for seamless workspace sharing from any device.
🪟 Flexible Screen Multiplexing: Nine workspace slots supporting infinite terminals, tabs, and windows designed specifically for human-in-the-loop and autonomous agent workflows.
🔌 Extensible Package Management: Easily install official and community extensions directly from Git repositories via the built-in package manager.

Whether you are running and monitoring multiple parallel autonomous AI coding agents across isolated slots, or syncing a heavy remote workstation to your laptop over an encrypted P2P network, Rune keeps your terminal states locked in and blazing fast.

Check out the repo, drop a star, and level up your terminal workflow today:
https://github.com/unstablebuild/rune

Stop fighting with AI-generated documents that completely ignore strict bureaucratic formatting standards! 📄❌

Meet mizzlelover/gongwen-gbt9704-skill, an open-source AI skill that bridges the gap between large language models and strict Chinese national government document formatting standards by programmatically generating compliant, editable DOCX files. 

If you are building document automation workflows for government agencies, state-owned enterprises, or public institutions, you already know the pain of font substitution, mismatched line spacing between Word and WPS, and millimeter-level layout errors. 

This repository solves that by providing a robust generation engine built around the GB/T 9704-2012 standard. Instead of relying on fragile prompt engineering, it programmatically handles complex layout constraints like A4 boundaries, font hierarchies (Xiao Biao Song, Fang Song), official document numbers, title structures, and pagination.

🚀 Key Features:
• Strict GB/T 9704-2012 Compliance: Manages precise page margins, explicit paragraph spacing, and precise font hierarchies.
• Flexible Red-Header Modes: Supports ordinary reports, preprinted red-header paper alignment, and full digital red headers.
• Cross-Platform AI Skill Integration: Packaged as a portable SKILL.md directory compatible with Claude Code, Kimi, OpenCode, Trae, WorkBuddy, and ZCode.
• Built-in Validation: Includes dedicated Node.js scripts to generate, verify, and audit DOCX outputs for print-ready, editable results.

Whether you want to embed this skill into internal AI assistants to turn raw meeting notes into official reports, or automate backend pipelines converting Markdown into clean DOCX deliverables, this reference implementation saves hours of manual post-formatting.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/mizzlelover/gongwen-gbt9704-skill
